basics.name: Sébastien Elet
basics.label: Staff Engineer · Node.js / TypeScript · B2B SaaS
basics.summary: At Septeo ADB, I lead the engineering team responsible for condominium management in Lobby. Over 19 years in software development, I've scaled SaaS platforms at startups and larger companies.

work.name: SEPTEO ADB

Lobby serves 90 property management firms, 681 users and 155,000 condominium owners.
